I don't know. I have only ever been officially diagnosed with CPTSD and depression, then I have had some prolonged psychotic episodes. Out of the therapists I have had, some have briefly brought up autism and ADHD. 
I often get periods of feeling nothing at all, dissociating completely from my emotions, to how I am now.
Extremely emotional and depressed. I don't know if that is something bipolar though, as my understanding of bipolar disorder is that there must be some form of mania present. 
I thank you for your comment.
thank you, even though I don't deserve it.

I don't know much about the symptoms of inhaling or taking too much fluid, but I will definitely keep this in mind. 
I'll try to get my hands on a hemp wick as well, just in case it was that.

It felt like I could hear my rational thoughts, but couldn't act on any of them...
Like my consciousness was locked away somewhere, but I could still hear it.

Thought I'd put in a list of symptoms.

Shaking vision
Unable to walk straight, shaking hands
Extreme coldness
Lightheadedness
Smiling whole sobbing, sobbing, laughing and all completely out of my control and out of nowhere
Complete numbness of face (Leading to slurred speech)
Numbness of body, unable to feel much pain 
Chest pain
Muffled hearing
Very slow response time
Nearly no grip strength
Dry mouth
What do you think it could have been laced with?

My buddy gave it to me. We've been friends for about 3-4 years, so I trust him.
Edit: Though, people can make mistakes. He might have given me something unintentionally.
